Demonstrated experience working in a Level 1 Trauma Center

The PACU nurse will collaborate with the Dept. of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Care and other surgical and interdisciplinary teams to develop and implement a plan of care for a specific group of assigned patients. Performs professional nursing duties that incorporate the psychomotor and age appropriate cognitive skills of the patient/family/significant other to assess, plan, intervene and advocate for the patient on an ongoing basis throughout the post anesthesia period. Will evaluate patient outcomes, effectiveness of plan of care, and readiness for discharge from PACU. Acts as a role model and mentor to a variety of students and nurses new to the unit. Functions as a (PCC) Patient Care Coordinator as requested by the supervisor/manager.
Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, and on call after hours as needed
Must be able to participate in on call rotation and work occasional weekends & evenings
Ability to work variable shifts including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays
Knowledge of Title 22 and Joint Commission Requirements
Ability to read, write and communicate effectively in English
Bilingual skills to communicate effectively with patients and families
Ability to maintain flexibility and work well in a fast paced, constantly changing environment
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
